verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships its own built-in assistant. `local-ai chat` is described as an agent in your shell that answers questions, reads your files and runs commands behind an approval gate you control. The docs also describe a built-in agent platform, with agents created and configured in the bundled web UI and given MCP tools. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of task delegation, and documentation of how deep delegation goes (e.g., whether the assistant can operate LocalAI itself, such as managing models, or chain multi-step tasks).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: local-ai chat reads your files and runs commands on your machine, behind an approval gate you control.
It answers questions, reads your files and runs commands on your machine, asking you to approve anything that changes state.
LocalAI includes a built-in AI agent platform with support for the [Model Context Protocol (MCP)]
LocalAI comes with a **built-in web interface** for chatting with models, managing installations, configuring AI agents, and more, with no extra tools needed.
